classification.difficultyReason: Use the taught calculator method to approximate each root, compare the decimals and translate their order into number-line positions.

content.prompt: Arrange the irrational numbers $\sqrt{3}$, $\sqrt{6}$, $\sqrt[3]{30}$ and $\sqrt[5]{60}$ in order of size on the number line.

answer.worked:
Calculator approximations, correct to two decimal places:

$\begin{align*}\sqrt{3}&\approx1.73\\\sqrt{6}&\approx2.45\\\sqrt[3]{30}&\approx3.11\\\sqrt[5]{60}&\approx2.27\end{align*}$

Place the numbers at these approximate positions on the number line, increasing from left to right:

$\sqrt{3}<\sqrt[5]{60}<\sqrt{6}<\sqrt[3]{30}$.
